evals.name: pepper-five-day-plan
evals.prompt: The planner-service plan for a plot is being reviewed by hand. Plot: bell pepper planted 2026-04-22, sand soil (registry says 83 mm of available water per metre), 400 m2, rows 1.2 m apart, emitters every 0.3 m, DripNet PC emitters of 1.6 L/h. The weather forecast for the next five days starting 2026-06-10 is fresh: ET0 6.5, 7.0, 7.0, 6.0, 6.0 mm and rain 0, 0, 5, 0, 0 mm. Produce the 5-day plan the planner should return: for each day Kc, need_mm, litres, run_minutes and the bucket level at the end of the day. State any assumptions. Do not ask me questions.
assertions: States TAW = 41.5 mm (sand 83 mm/m x root depth 0.5 m) and an irrigation trigger of 20.75 mm (half of the bucket)
Day 1 Kc is about 0.857 (development stage of the 30/35/40/20 day pepper curve, Kc 0.6 to 1.05) and day 5 Kc is about 0.909
Days 1 to 4 have need_mm 0, litres 0 and run_minutes 0
End-of-day bucket levels for days 1 to 4 are about 35.93, 29.84, 28.66 and 23.28 mm (within 0.5%)
Day 5 need_mm is about 23.67 and the end-of-day level is 41.5
Day 5 litres is about 9467 and run_minutes about 319.5 (rate 4.444 mm/h from 1.6 L/h on 1.2 x 0.3 m)
States that the bucket starts full at the beginning of the plan

evals.name: tomato-past-season-rain
evals.prompt: Same planner, another plot. Tomato planted 2025-01-01 in clay loam (registry: 200 mm of available water per metre), 1000 m2, rows 1.5 m apart, emitters every 0.4 m at 1.0 L/h. The fresh forecast for 4 days starting 2026-07-01 has ET0 7.0 mm every day and rain 0, 60, 0, 0 mm. Give Kc, need_mm, litres, run_minutes and the end-of-day bucket level for each day, and explain how you chose Kc given the planting date. Do not ask me questions.
evals.expected_output: Kc 0.80 all days (planting date is past the 145-day season, Kc end held); TAW 140; levels 134.4, 140.0, 134.4, 128.8; no irrigation
assertions: States TAW = 140 mm (clay loam 200 mm/m x root depth 0.7 m)
Uses Kc = 0.80 on all four days
Explains that the planting date is past the end of the season (about 145 days) so Kc end is held
End-of-day bucket levels are about 134.4, 140.0, 134.4 and 128.8 mm, with the 60 mm rain capped at the bucket size
need_mm, litres and run_minutes are 0 on all four days

evals.name: pepper-parameters
evals.prompt: I'm adding a new crop test to planner-service. For bell pepper in clay loam soil (registry: 200 mm of available water per metre), what bucket size (TAW), trigger level, root depth, stage lengths and Kc ini / Kc mid / Kc end does the planner use? Do not ask me questions.
evals.expected_output: TAW 100 mm, trigger 50 mm, root depth 0.5 m, stages 30/35/40/20, Kc 0.6/1.05/0.90
assertions: Root depth is 0.5 m and TAW = 100 mm
Trigger level is 50 mm (half of the bucket)
Stage lengths are 30/35/40/20 days
Kc ini 0.6, Kc mid 1.05 and Kc end 0.90

evals.name: bucket-example-first-irrigation
evals.prompt: In the planner's bucket model, a 70 mm bucket loses 7 mm every day with no rain. Which day does the planner first irrigate, how many mm does that irrigation apply, and what is the bucket level at the end of that day? Do not ask me questions.
evals.expected_output: Day 6 (level would drop to 28, below the 35 trigger); applies 42 mm; ends at 70 mm
assertions: Says the first irrigation is on day 6 (day 5 ends at exactly 35 mm, which does not trigger)
Says the irrigation applies 42 mm
Says the end-of-day level on that day is 70 mm
States that the bucket starts full on day 1
